# DIMISIPEDIA — Official Corporate Knowledge Base of DIMISI Technologies

> DIMISIPEDIA is the authoritative entity knowledge platform, architecture chronicle, and public credibility record of DIMISI Technologies Private Limited (CIN: U62013UP2026PTC246506), an incorporated Indian technology enterprise headquartered in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh.

## Corporate Identity & Registration
- Legal Entity: DIMISI Technologies Private Limited
- CIN: U62013UP2026PTC246506
- Incorporation Date: 9 April 2026
- Registered Office: MIG 3/131, Swarn Jayanti Vihar, Koyala Nagar, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh 208011, India
- Official Website: https://dimisi.tech
- Knowledge Platform: https://www.dimisipedia.me
- Nature: Independent corporate knowledge repository documenting company entities, leadership, and products with verifiable sources.

## Executive Leadership & Founders
- Shikhar Dixit — Founder, Chief Executive Officer (CEO) & Director. Led early engineering sprints from Gandhigiri technical project at Axis College, CATI, and incorporated DIMISI Technologies. Profile: https://www.dimisipedia.me/people/shikhar-dixit
- Swatantra Singh — Co-Founder, Chief Technology Officer (CTO) & Director. Directs engineering infrastructure, architecture, and security. Profile: https://www.dimisipedia.me/people/swatantra-singh
- Nishkarsh Mishra — Co-Founder, Director, Chief Operating Officer (COO) & Chief Marketing Officer (CMO). Oversees operations, brand marketing, and institutional partnerships. Profile: https://www.dimisipedia.me/people/nishkarsh-mishra
- First Mentor: Jayendra Pratap Singh (Startup Advisor at Wadhwani Foundation, DPIIT Platinum Badge Awardee). Profile: https://www.dimisipedia.me/people/jayendra-pratap-singh

## Key Products & Engineering Ecosystem
- The Kalesh (https://thekalesh.com) — Flagship anonymous social polling and engagement platform.
- KAAND — Next-generation mobile news and media platform.
- CATI Khelghar — Offline-first pass-and-play casual games platform.
- DIMISI-OPS — Internal task management, workforce operations, and administrative portal.
- DIMISIPEDIA — Structured entity knowledge base and verification platform.

## Engineering Stack & Architecture
- Frameworks: React, TypeScript, TanStack Start, TanStack Router, Vite, Tailwind CSS.
- Cloud & Infrastructure: Cloudflare Workers / Nitro SSR, Supabase, Vercel.
- Mobile: Flutter, Dart, Android Native.
